system.description:
Any character can climb a tree or scramble up a scree-covered slope without needing to make a roll. For steeper and more difficult climbs, such as climbing up a rough cliff or a wall with uneven brickwork a character without the Climb Walls talent may make a Climbing roll to successfully complete the climb (if it is a long climb, a roll per 100' is required).

Characters with the Climb Walls talent can climb things that a character without the talent would need to make a Climbing roll for. Additionally, by making a Climb Walls roll they are able to climb things that someone without the talent would not even get a roll for, such as walls made from close-fitting stone blocks with only the tiniest of handholds.

Even surfaces like smooth glass can be climbed with a successful roll using the Climb Walls talent, although such extreme climbs should be given a modifier to the roll by the Gameguide.
